needs.keys_note: A voice needs the buyer's own key for one service: ElevenLabs (exact word timing, the house voice), OpenAI or Fish Audio. Instagram through Composio is optional and only steers topics.

deps.platform: macOS, Windows or Linux. Rendering, voice and checks are the same everywhere; a voice without word timestamps is timed by whisper.cpp, which the folder fetches once.
deps.ffmpeg: the machine's own ffmpeg and ffprobe, because the engine's scripts call them by name
deps.python: numpy, run through the folder's Python runner (scripts/py.mjs), no python3 on the PATH needed
deps.node: remotion and @remotion/google-fonts from the folder's own package.json
deps.browser: the headless shell Remotion fetches; CHROME overrides it

deps.platform: macOS, Windows or Linux. A Mac uses Apple speech (through auto-editor) and Apple Vision; Windows and Linux use whisper.cpp with voice detection (scripts/transcribe.mjs) and OpenCV's face finder (engine/scripts/facekit/measure_face_cv.py). Proven on a Mac, with the Windows path exercised on that Mac; not yet run on a Windows machine.

deps.browser: the headless shell Remotion fetches; CHROME overrides it for page captures

install.win32: winget install -e --id Python.Python.3.12 --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements & py -3 -c "import shutil,sys,os; shutil.copy(sys.executable, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(sys.executable), 'python3.exe'))"

default: import PIL, numpy, matplotlib, scipy, cv2

install.darwin: python3 -m pip install --user pillow numpy matplotlib scipy || python3 -m pip install --user --break-system-packages pillow numpy matplotlib scipy
install.default: python3 -m pip install --user pillow numpy matplotlib scipy opencv-python-headless || python3 -m pip install --user --break-system-packages pillow numpy matplotlib scipy opencv-python-headless
